summary: Iteration 6 frontend validation for Nekhwa: Qatari visual elements (splash palm trees + dhow + 8-point star pattern), emoji allergen icons in 3-col grid, gamified donor tier card (Oryx Guardian @ 642 meals → 358 to Falcon Helper), and simplified Impact Dashboard (4 stat cards only). All 7 acceptance criteria PASS on mobile viewport (390x844) via the public preview URL.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings (non-blocking): 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated, use style.pointerEvents' from QatariPattern.tsx (pointerEvents='none' on View). Also 'useNativeDriver not supported' on web — expected for Expo web and harmless.

validation_results.1_splash_qatari_elements: PASS — testID splash-screen present with 8-point star pattern overlay (rotated square motifs), two PalmTree silhouettes in bottom-left/right corners, and a centered DhowBoat that bobs via Animated.loop. Screenshot confirms all three decorative layers over COLORS.primary background.
validation_results.2_donor_tier_card: PASS — testID donor-tier-card renders with 🦌 emoji, 'Your Title' label, tier name 'Oryx Guardian', '642 meals', and progress text '358 meals to Falcon Helper 🦅'. Card background uses tier.color (#D4A373). Math verified: MY_TOTAL_MEALS=642, oryx threshold=500, falcon=1000 → 1000-642=358. Progress bar width = (642-500)/(1000-500) = 28.4%.
validation_results.3_leaderboard_below_tier: PASS — testID donor-leaderboard appears after tier card, top 5 rows rendered (Fatima 🥇 1240, Mohammed 🥈 980, Sara 🥉 870, Ahmed (You) #4 642, Layla #5 510). Current user row highlighted via lbRowMe style. Rank pill shows '#4 · 642 meals'.
validation_results.4_allergen_icon_grid: PASS — Donate screen (quick mode, meals=10<50) shows all 6 allergen testIDs (allergen-gluten/dairy/nuts/seafood/eggs/soy) in a 3-column flex-wrap grid (width 31% each). Each chip displays emoji (🌾🥛🥜🦐🥚🫘) above label. Tap toggled selection and applied allergenChipActive style (accent tint + green border).
validation_results.5_impact_modal_simplified: PASS — Hero card has QatariPattern overlay, LIVE • QATAR badge (green dot), heroValue 184,620 at fontSize 64, divider, people-fed row with 🌟 emoji + 61,540 + 'people fed across Qatar'. Weekly bar chart renders with 'This Week' title + '+12%' pill. Food categories stacked bar + 2-col legend. Footer: '🇶🇦 Together we rescue more'. Confirmed ABSENT: monthly trend, top areas, top NGOs, peak hours, response time.
validation_results.6_four_stat_cards: PASS — Exactly 4 impact-stat-* testIDs detected: meals(🍽️ 184,620), waste(🌿 42.4t), co2(☁️ 106t), vol(👥 312). Each card has colored left border (red/green/blue/orange). Legacy testIDs water/del/areas/time are fully removed from DOM.
validation_results.7_arabic_rtl: PASS — Switching language to العربية flips content: tier card becomes '🦌 لقبك / حارس المها / 642 وجبة / 358 وجبة متبقية لـ الصقر المعين 🦅'; impact footer becomes '🇶🇦 معاً نُنقذ المزيد من الطعام'. Hero label reads 'وجبات أنقذت'. Screenshot confirms mirrored layout (stat cards and hero content right-aligned).

action_items: Cosmetic: replace <View pointerEvents='none' /> with style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }} in QatariPattern.tsx to silence the RN 0.74+ deprecation warning.
Optional: the leaderboard header '#4 · 642 meals' pill wraps oddly on very narrow widths; consider shortening to '#4' on mobile <360px.
critical_code_review_comments: gamification.ts getTier loops correctly but relies on sorted thresholds; add an assertion or sort at module load to prevent regressions if a tier is inserted out of order.

home.tsx renderTierCard Arabic branch uses template literal '${next.threshold - MY_TOTAL_MEALS} وجبة متبقية لـ ${nextName}' — works, but Farsi ('fa') falls through to the English branch and will show 'meals to' instead of a Farsi translation. Worth adding a fa-specific string for parity.
QatariPattern.tsx renders 36 absolute views per mount — negligible on mobile, but consider memoizing cells array.
seed_data_creation: None — all data still mocked via /src/data/mockData.ts. MOCKED APIS confirmed by main agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Splash auto-redirects to /role-select after 1800ms. Donor role shows home with testIDs: donor-tier-card, donor-leaderboard, home-impact-hero, hero-see-full-impact, home-action-donate. Donate screen allergens visible only when meals<50 (quick mode). Impact modal testIDs: impact-modal, impact-back-btn, impact-backdrop, impact-stat-{meals|waste|co2|vol} (only 4, removed 4). Farsi ('fa') tier strings fall back to English template — consider adding fa branch. MY_TOTAL_MEALS=642, MY_RANK=4 in mockData.
